info.title: Project Owner Work Planning
info.description: Owner-only planning for an existing initialized Project. Real Account cookie, Host/Origin/Fetch-Metadata and CSRF boundaries apply; an administrator has no cross-Owner bypass. Read/Lookup/completed replay remain available when archived; new mutations require active. Pending initialization/deleting are rejected. Project creation, real Skills initialization, Task transitions/assignment, Agent execution and UI are not provided. Query is bounded to 32768 raw bytes and rejects unknown, duplicate decoded, empty, malformed UTF-8/percent/NUL, semicolon, no-equals and bare-question-mark forms. Success bodies are completely validated before publication: detail/mutation/Lookup 1 MiB, list 5 MiB. Byte caps, Unicode classifications, ordering, cross-field identity/time/version rules and duplicate JSON keys are enforced by the original Go contracts and HTTP decoder in addition to this schema. Native timeout/short write/Close/Flush/clear failure aborts; it does not prove a command was not committed. Persist the original body, path, generated IDs and Idempotency-Key before sending, then explicitly Lookup after a lost response.

post.description: Thirty-second total deadline starts before authentication and includes body Close, complete output, Flush and cancellation callback join; earlier parent deadlines win. Current Human Owner and original Account CSRF/Origin only. Strict JSON <=1 MiB, no query/bare ?, encoding, duplicate/unknown/case-folded keys, invalid UTF-8/surrogates or trailing values. Exactly one original Idempotency-Key. expected_version is the original Sprint version, not the Project version; request is exactly {}. Lookup recomputes StartSprintDigest from the saved original target/version and current User; it never calls Start or current GET. Unknown retains the original safe Problem and lookup hint. Missing lifecycle service fails DEPENDENCY_UNBOUND. Start allows empty Sprints and a paused Scheduler; it neither enables nor launches scheduling. No automatic initialization or Sprint completion.

browserSession.description: Original Account Session; configured loopback HTTP uses agenteam_local_session. No caller Actor or bearer bypass.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Exactly one original key, unchanged and not trimmed; duplicate header values rejected, including identical ones.

CSRF.name: X-CSRF-Token
CSRF.description: Actual current Account Session CSRF token; POST Lookup is unsafe and also requires it.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Canonical decimal only, no leading zeros.

Problem.description: Safe shared Problem with original commit_state and lawful hint, never error text or a candidate receipt. Failed publication after a successful mutation aborts the connection instead of asserting rollback.

Title.description: At most 1024 UTF-8 bytes and 256 Unicode scalar values, at least one non-Unicode-whitespace character; no Cc controls. No trimming or normalization.

Description.description: At most 32768 UTF-8 bytes; Cc controls other than tab, LF and CR are forbidden. Omitted create values become empty strings.

Plan.description: At most 32768 UTF-8 bytes; same control-character rules as Description. Omitted create value becomes empty string.

Rank.description: Server assigned rank; caller input never accepts this field.

Cursor.description: Opaque signed continuation, at most 8192 UTF-8 bytes. Invalid or stale cursors never become first-page requests. Limit is not bound.

ActorHistory.description: Validated historical actor, never a current authorization. Service name/cause_ref must meet the original identity registry; scoped actors must match this Project. Session is never exposed.

Sprint.description: Original lifecycle and timestamp ordering are validated. Sprint Start is exposed through its separate lifecycle command; this API does not complete Sprints.

Task.description: Full current or historical Task. Reading an assigned or non-backlog Task does not enable mutation of that state. Parent IDs and times are validated by the service and HTTP projection.

BlockerDescription.description: At most 1024 UTF-8 bytes, including empty or whitespace-only text; tab/LF/CR allowed, other Cc controls rejected.

ResolutionComment.description: When not null, at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes and at least one non-Unicode-whitespace character; empty or whitespace-only strings are invalid. Same Cc control rules as Description.

oneOf.description: Persisted Scheduler technical Blocker read projection. Original metadata.reference_id equals created_by.cause_id and both remain unchanged by resolution. Resolved records retain the original System creator and use a Human resolved_by; resolved_at is not earlier than created_at. The typed response validator enforces these relationships. This read variant does not permit Human Add or Transfer to create technical Blockers.

TaskBlocker.description: Human rely_on/waiting_for_human and Scheduler technical read projections. Resolved time is no earlier than creation; maximum encoded record is 16 KiB.

BlockerAddRequest.description: Original DTO cap 8 KiB. Other known future Blocker kinds are not enabled and return DEPENDENCY_UNBOUND.

MilestoneReorderRequest.description: Omission means the group tail. Explicit null is invalid; self-anchor is invalid.

SprintReorderRequest.description: Explicit destination Milestone; before_id omission means group tail. Moving a Sprint with Tasks follows the original Structure rules.

TaskCreateRequest.description: Description/plan default to empty; omitted initial_state means backlog. Valid DTO inputs for another initial state or an assignee reach the original explicit business rejection; this HTTP does not silently ignore them. Task planning creates only unassigned backlog Tasks.

TaskReorderRequest.description: Only current group ordering; omitted before_id means tail. No new parent/state/priority/assignee input.

StructureLookupRequest.description: Saved original intent, available before the first send. Use the original Idempotency-Key. RequestID is fresh but not part of the semantic digest. No caller digest, namespace or current Get reconstruction.

TaskLookupRequest.description: Saved original intent, available before the first send. Use the original Idempotency-Key. RequestID is fresh but not part of the semantic digest. No caller digest, namespace or current Get reconstruction.

BlockerLookupRequest.description: Saved original intent, available before the first send. Use the original Idempotency-Key. RequestID is fresh but not part of the semantic digest. No caller digest, namespace or current Get reconstruction.

BlockerMutation.description: Task version is expected_version + 1, with matching Project/Task and update time. No private command plan, key, digest or Session fields.

StructureLookup.description: Historical committed receipt, never reconstructed from current fields. Neither not_observed nor in_progress authorizes automatic resubmission.

TaskLookup.description: Historical committed receipt, never reconstructed from current fields. Neither not_observed nor in_progress authorizes automatic resubmission.

BlockerLookup.description: Historical committed receipt, never reconstructed from current fields. Neither not_observed nor in_progress authorizes automatic resubmission.

MilestoneSummaryPage.description: Complete validated page, at most 5 MiB; items never null, no next_cursor when exhausted. Each summary or Blocker is bounded to 16 KiB. No description/plan fields in summaries.

SprintSummaryPage.description: Complete validated page, at most 5 MiB; items never null, no next_cursor when exhausted. Each summary or Blocker is bounded to 16 KiB. No description/plan fields in summaries.

TaskSummaryPage.description: Complete validated page, at most 5 MiB; items never null, no next_cursor when exhausted. Each summary or Blocker is bounded to 16 KiB. No description/plan fields in summaries.

TaskBlockerPage.description: Complete validated page, at most 5 MiB; items never null, no next_cursor when exhausted. Each summary or Blocker is bounded to 16 KiB. No description/plan fields in summaries.

comment.description: 1..32768 UTF-8 bytes, at least one non-Unicode-whitespace character; original bytes are retained. Only TAB/LF/CR control characters are allowed.

TaskTransferRequest.description: Original strict TaskTransfer DTO, <=512 KiB. All explicit null values are rejected. Omitted assignee retains the stored value; no assignee clearing. Omitted blocker sets normalize to empty; each <=16, combined <=32, unique IDs across both sets; additions canonicalized by blocker_id. Only Human-allowed state edges are accepted by the domain; todo -> in_progress remains Scheduler-only. This transport does not bypass current Agent, occupancy, pending, Sprint or Blocker rules.

TaskTransitionLookupRequest.description: Saved original intent, available before the first send. Use the original Idempotency-Key. RequestID is fresh but not part of the semantic digest. No caller digest, namespace or current Get reconstruction.

TaskTransitionMutation.description: Complete original Task receipt; task.version is exactly expected_version+1, task.state equals the requested target, and any explicitly requested assignee matches. Task history IDs are strictly increasing and unique. Historical replay returns the same receipt without consulting current Get. No changed=false branch.

TaskTransitionLookup.description: Historical committed receipt, never reconstructed from current fields. Neither not_observed nor in_progress authorizes automatic resubmission.

SprintStartLookupRequest.description: Saved original target and Sprint version; no caller digest, Actor, Project version or replacement request. Same User with a new authorized Session may look up the original key.

description.description: At most 8192 UTF-8 bytes; server validates this byte bound. Tabs and newlines are allowed.

SprintStartProject.description: Original active ProjectRef postimage, with current_sprint_id equal to the receipt Sprint ID; absent archived_at follows its actual domain encoding. The service changes Project and Sprint atomically; HTTP does not accept a caller Project version or consult a later GET.

SprintStartMutation.description: Exact original Sprint/Project/Event postimage. Sprint version is original expected+1, Project current pointer equals Sprint, both updated_at values agree, and started_by is the original Human User. Complete domain validation precedes publication; a bad success projection aborts instead of inventing an uncommitted Problem.

SprintStartLookup.description: Public projection of domain State/Result; null receipt is required outside committed. Lookup is read-only and neither nonterminal state authorizes automatic resubmission.
